hypothesis: H-PUMPPULSE: pump.fun platform activity (DefiLlama daily bonding-curve revenue) z-score predicts next-day(s) returns of a memecoin perp basket, SOL-hedged or unhedged (sources/leads/documented_edges_round10.md idea 3; scope reports/scope_memecoins_20261005.md)
frozen_before: any activity value, kline price, return or P&L was computed by this agent. Before freezing, only (a) HTTP status codes of DefiLlama endpoints, (b) JSON key structure, child-protocol names and first/last dates of the series, and (c) first/last dates of the existing daily kline/funding parquet files were inspected.
rationale: Lead idea 3 (round 10): launchpad retail flow as a days-scale regime signal for the liquid meme complex. Evidence is weak (no published lead-lag). Main kill risk named in advance: reverse causality (meme prices move first, pump.fun activity follows), and one correlated bet per day. No parent hypothesis / failing run in this repo.

activity.primary: https://api.llama.fi/summary/fees/pump?dataType=dailyRevenue -> totalDataChartBreakdown[ts]['Solana']['pump.fun'] (bonding-curve child only: protocol slice of curve trade fee + graduation + Mayhem fees). Parent total is NOT used because PumpSwap (from 2025-03) and Terminal enter as structural steps.
activity.robustness_only: https://api.llama.fi/summary/dexs/pump.fun totalDataChart (bonding-curve volume, starts 2024-04-26) = curve inflow proxy; run ONLY on the selected config, never selectable.
activity.launches: No unauthenticated DefiLlama endpoint gives daily pump.fun launch counts; not tested (NULL). Hourly curve SOL inflow from our recorder is forward-only and not part of this daily registration.
activity.auth: All three DefiLlama endpoints above returned HTTP 200 without a key (2026-10-05). api.llama.fi/summary/fees/pump-launchpad returned 400.
activity.point_in_time: DefiLlama daily values are UTC-day totals keyed by the day's 00:00 UTC timestamp. Day d is usable only after it closes; we assume a 6 h publication lag, so day d's value is used at 06:00 UTC on d+1. CAVEAT: the API serves the CURRENT revision (adapter back-fills/methodology changes, e.g. fee slice 1% -> 0.95% on 2025-05-13), not the vintage visible at the time; no vintage archive exists. This is a stated, unremovable look-ahead risk in the level of the series (not in timing).

data.prices: data.binance.vision USDT-M 1h klines (futures/um/monthly/klines/<SYM>/1h), months 2024-01..2026-03 only; rows >= 2026-04-01 dropped before writing. Cache data/raw/web/pumppulse/k1h/<SYM>.parquet. Daily klines for tiers reused read-only from data/raw/web/momentum/klines.
data.funding: Binance fundingRate monthly archive, reused read-only from data/raw/web/momentum/funding/<SYM>.parquet (ends 2026-03).
data.download_guard: < 300 MB total under data/raw/web/pumppulse/; stop if free disk < 2.5 GB.

universe.membership: point in time: a symbol is in the basket for an episode if it has >= 30 daily bars with quote_volume > 0 before the entry day (counting only bars of the current contract) and an hourly bar at entry and exit. Equal weight at entry, no intra-episode rebalancing. Early train (2024) basket is only 1000PEPE/1000BONK/WIF; others join as they pass the 30-bar rule.
universe.hedge: SOLUSDT, notional equal to the basket notional (1:1).

signal.A_d: pump.fun curve revenue (USD) for UTC day d
signal.level_z: z_d = (ln A_d - mean(ln A_{d-28..d-1})) / std(ln A_{d-28..d-1})
signal.missing: if A_d is missing or <= 0, no signal that day; z requires >= 20 valid values in the window

trade.entry: 06:00 UTC on d+1 (1h kline open), using z_d
trade.direction: z_d >= k: long basket (short SOL if hedged); z_d <= -k: short basket (long SOL if hedged). Unhedged configs trade the basket alone, both directions.
trade.exit: 06:00 UTC on d+1+H (open of that 1h bar)
trade.overlap: non-overlapping: signals are only evaluated while flat; the day after an exit the next signal is z of the latest closed day.
trade.trade_unit: each basket-day of an open position is one trade (daily mark-to-market slice at 06:00 UTC); entry costs charged to the first slice, exit costs to the last, funding to the slice in which it prints. Independent signals = episodes, also reported.

costs.primary_binance: per leg per side: 5 bp taker + slippage tier by the symbol's trailing-30d mean daily quote volume (days before entry): >= $1B 2 bp; $200M-1B 5 bp; $50M-200M 10 bp; < $50M 20 bp (same tiers as momentum prereg). Basket legs weighted equally; SOL hedge leg charged on equal notional. Funding: every Binance funding print with calc_time in (entry, exit]; longs pay rate, shorts receive.
costs.sensitivity: slippage x2 reported for the selected config (never selected on).
costs.lighter_info_only: 0 bp fee + 3 bp spread per leg per side, Binance funding as proxy. Information only; not a pass criterion.

grid.not_in_grid: long-only variants, other windows, curve-volume series: reported for information only if at all, never selectable.

splits.train: episodes entered 2024-04-01 .. 2025-06-30 and exiting by 2025-06-30 23:59 UTC (first date set by 28-day warm-up from 2024-03-01 data start)
splits.holdout: 2026-04-01+ NEVER touched: no price for >= 2026-04-01 is downloaded or loaded; activity values for those dates exist in the cached JSON (the API returns the full history) but are dropped at load.

bar: per split, primary Binance costs, unit = basket-day trade: n >= 50, net sum > 0, PF > 1.2, net sum excluding the 3 best basket-days > 0. Also report episodes (independent signals), per-year results, daily t-stat, long/short split.
selection: ONE config chosen on train: among configs passing the train bar, the highest train net mean per basket-day; if none pass, the config with the highest train net mean is run on validation for information only (verdict FAIL). Validation run exactly once for that config.
verdict: PASS only if the selected config passes the bar on both train and validation. Otherwise FAIL -> reports/failures/agent_pumppulse.md.

amendments.before: any activity value, return or P&L was computed
amendments.change: Removed an unverified claim that PUMP listed 2025-07-14. Archive check (dates, close level and volume only): PUMPUSDT bars 2025-04-12..2025-07-09 belong to an earlier, different contract (close ~0.12 then flat 0.0471 with zero volume); the pump.fun PUMP contract starts 2025-07-10 (close 0.0052). Rule: PUMPUSDT is used only from 2025-07-10; bars with zero quote volume never count toward the 30-bar rule.
